mechanism: Amikacin, an aminoglycoside antibiotic, can cause nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity which may indirectly affect buspirone metabolism and CNS effects through altered renal function and potential for enhanced CNS penetration.
action: Monitor renal function closely during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; consider therapeutic drug monitoring for amikacin; assess for CNS symptoms and adjust buspirone dosing if renal impairment develops.
